# Banner source

`banner.html` is the self-contained source of `../banner-light.png` and `../banner-dark.png`. It draws the FIG. 1 drawing, fonts and colours in HTML, CSS and inline SVG, and loads its fonts from Google Fonts. A `prefers-color-scheme: dark` media query gives the dark variant.

- **What goes here:** editable sources for the README images only, no rendered output.
- **Naming:** keep `banner.html`; the root README links to the rendered PNG names, so keep those stable too.
- **Notes for agents:** render both schemes at 1600x600 (see `../README.md`), view both PNGs before committing, and never put personal, client, account or other private data in the design. Decorative charts and documents must stay obviously illustrative.
